name: SearchFixture.Interleaved.witness

name: SearchFixture.add_comm
type: ∀ (n m : Nat), n + m = m + n

name: SearchFixture.append_length
type: ∀ (xs ys : List Nat), (xs ++ ys).length = xs.length + ys.length

name: SearchFixture.bit_and
type: ∀ (n m : Nat), n &&& m = n &&& m

name: SearchFixture.bit_or
type: ∀ (n m : Nat), n ||| m = n ||| m

name: SearchFixture.bit_shift_left
type: ∀ (n m : Nat), n <<< m = n <<< m

name: SearchFixture.bit_shift_right
type: ∀ (n m : Nat), n >>> m = n >>> m

name: SearchFixture.bit_xor
type: ∀ (n m : Nat), n ^^^ m = n ^^^ m

name: SearchFixture.conditional
type: ∀ (n m : Nat), (if n ≤ m then n + 1 else m * 2) = if n ≤ m then n + 1 else m * 2

name: SearchFixture.conditional_add
type: ∀ (n m : Nat), (n + if n ≤ m then 1 else 0) = n + if n ≤ m then 1 else 0

name: SearchFixture.cons_mem

doc: A fixture documenting addition and its symmetry.

type: ∀ (n m : Nat), n = m → n.succ = m.succ

name: SearchFixture.forall_body
type: ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (n : Nat), f n = f n

name: SearchFixture.iff_imp_left
type: ∀ (p q : Prop), p → q ↔ p → q

name: SearchFixture.lambda_match_field
type:
∀ (xs : List Nat),
  (List.map
        (fun n =>
          match n with
          | 0 => 0
          | n.succ => n)
        xs).reverse =
    (List.map
        (fun n =>
          match n with
          | 0 => 0
          | n.succ => n)
        xs).reverse

SearchFixture.mul_comm

name: SearchFixture.option_seq

name: SearchFixture.option_seq_left
type: ∀ (a b : Option Nat), a <* b = a <* b

name: SearchFixture.option_seq_right
type: ∀ (a b : Option Nat), a *> b = a *> b

name: SearchFixture.option_then
type: ∀ {α : Type} [inst : AndThen α] (a b : α), a >> b = a >> b

name: SearchFixture.succ_mem_cons
type: ∀ (n : Nat) (xs : List Nat), n.succ ∈ n.succ :: xs
